title: Forever Frost
description: Forever Frost is a small mod that transforms every biome into snow and ice and prevents it from melting.
body:
This mod transforms your entire world into a snow and ice landscape. The ocean is a vast expanse of ice, and the snow and ice do not melt during the day.

The normal biome selection remains intact. It is compatible with other biome mods like "Terralith" or snow mods such as "Snowrealmagic".

Planned update. 
- Server-side only (not yet implemented!)
- Snow on Grass Block
- Smooth Snow
